messages.subject: Dynamic wellPanel containing textInput
parts:
Hi, 
I hope that someone could help me and give an idea to create the following : I would like to fill a wellPanel with a  number i of textInput, i being a variable
I put this code in a uiOutput but this still not working : 

## server.R ##
 output$labelsNames <- renderUI({
    
    isolate(input$nLabels)
    wellPanel(
       for (i in 1:input$nLabels)
        {
        inputid <- paste("label", i, sep="")
        label <- paste("Label", i, sep=" ")
         textInput(inputid, label, "")
      }
    )
  })
  

Regards

Sam
